note: Real briefs, not smoke tests. Step 5 reads numbers the platform measured and turns them into promises; each brief is a way those promises come out stronger than the measurement. The deterministic half (a measured number with no denominator, a target not labelled forecast) is the geo-strategy-pack contract; the rest is graded against these lists.

briefs.title: 诺和盈（司美格鲁肽注射液）：基线之后的信源与三档目标
briefs.why: The engines differ sharply in how often they search the web for a weight-management question. A plan that promises the same mention gain on every engine promises what a model's own knowledge cannot deliver in twelve weeks.
mustDo: Read every rate from the platform's metrics with its numerator and denominator, and write 样本不足 for a cell under 30 answers.
Set each engine's promise ceiling from its measured retrieval rate: accuracy only where it rarely searches.
Classify each answer gap into one of the seven classes and rank them by consequence times question weight.
Check each candidate outlet for the three conditions and blacklist an impostor with the date checked.
Write three tiers with placements and a suggested budget, targets labelled forecast, acceptance by net effect against the control groups, accuracy ≥ 98% and zero traceable 讲错我方 in every tier.
mustNotDo: Type a rate that geo_read did not return.
Label a published study's citation share as measured on this project.
Promise a rank for a group no engine mentions today.
Put a control group into the layout or the placement plan.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether every promise in the report is no stronger than the engine's measured behaviour, and every number traces to a snapshot.

briefs.title: 信尔美：只做信源分析与预期（最小上游）
briefs.why: The most common single step. With no question set the platform first measures a minimal 30; the plan then has to stand on 30 questions per engine and say so, not read as a full diagnosis.
mustDo: State at the top that the question set is a minimal one and what the conclusions therefore cover.
Mark strategy.json minimal: true and keep per-engine cells at their real sample.
Leave net effect and trend out: a minimal round has no control arm and no history.
mustNotDo: Write pool-level rates as if they came from a full question map.
Compare the minimal round's numbers with any later full round.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the minimal scope is visible on the first screen of the report and in every number's sample.

briefs.title: 波立维：基线里出现讲错我方
briefs.why: One engine answers that 波立维 can be taken with 奥美拉唑 with no caution, citing a content farm. A plan that counts that answer as a mention win, or routes it to more content instead of correction, spends the budget on the wrong thing.
mustDo: Treat the misstatement as 讲错我方: trace the cited source, its attribute and the action it calls for, and hand the correction to the content step.
Keep a mention inside a wrong statement out of the visibility gains.
Put the content farm on the source table as a source to cover, never to place with.
mustNotDo: Write interaction advice to patients in the strategy report.
Recommend contacting or paying the content farm.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the wrong statement drives the plan (correction first) rather than inflating it.

briefs.title: 信尔美：覆盖层候选逐个核三条件，并写进平台
briefs.why: Production 2026-09-25: the strategy run checked two of its coverage candidates, wrote the three conditions under the method's own field names, and the platform recorded none of them — 963 sources with no condition checked, and the market could not tell a checked outlet from an unchecked one. A later write of the sources alone then left the latest strategy version empty, so the page showed no battlefield and no promise.
mustDo: Check every coverage-layer candidate (10–20 sites) for ICP holder, news indexing and medical vertical, each with the day checked; write null where a condition could not be checked.
Write each source with icpMatches, newsIndexed, medicalVertical and checkedAt, and each engine's expectation with promise and layers.
Write every tier's project-wide targets for M-19 and M-01S beside the per-pool ones.
Read back geo_read strategy after writing and confirm the battlefield, the expectations and the layout are all present.
mustNotDo: Mark a coverage candidate as placeable when a condition is null.
Write only the sources in a second strategy write and assume the rest is kept without reading it back.
Count lillymedical.cn or any rival holder's domain as an owned source.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether every coverage candidate carries a dated verdict on all three conditions in the platform's record, and the strategy the page reads is complete.

briefs.title: 信尔美：每个答案缺口都有对应的行动，或一句不做的理由
briefs.why: A strategy that ranks twenty gaps and then plans nothing for them leaves the reader to guess which gap an article is for. The platform lists the actions by gap; a gap with neither an action nor a stated reason is a gap nobody answered.

inputs.note: 基线已测完的项目；缺口里既有可写稿的，也有交纠错流程的。

mustDo: Write one actions[] entry for every gap, or an entry with only gapId and a reason where nothing is to be written for it (a correction of a traced 讲错我方 error, a gap only to be watched).
Name, for each action, the article layer and the channel (an owned platform's id or media_market), the engines the promise holds on, and why each source (sources[].why).
Give each action a promise from the platform's list and the basis it rests on, in a sentence.
mustNotDo: Leave a gap with neither an action nor a reason.
Write the same action twice for one gap, or an action for a control group.
briefs.gradedOn: `node evals/geo-strategy/check-actions.mjs <strategy.json>` — case everyGapAnswered holds (no gap_without_action notice).

briefs.title: 信尔美：行动的预期指标是该语义群所在池的指标
briefs.why: The expected metric of an action is read against the group's own pool: mention for a pool that is about brand identity or accuracy would be judged on a number that cannot move with the work. The owner's table (metrics_by_pool) names what each pool is judged on.
mustDo: Choose each action's metricId from its group's pool: P1 M-06 or M-03; P2 M-01, M-02, M-06 or M-08; P3 M-01 or M-08; P4 M-15.
Leave the target number to the platform (the chosen tier's row for the pool) and say what the move rests on in basis.
mustNotDo: Name a metric the group's pool is not judged on, or the project index as an action's metric.
briefs.gradedOn: `node evals/geo-strategy/check-actions.mjs <strategy.json>` — case metricInPool holds (no metric_not_in_pool notice).

briefs.title: 信尔美：行动里不写没有依据的目标数字
briefs.why: A target typed into an action is a second number beside the targets table's, and a number without its basis reads as a promise the platform cannot stand behind. What an action promises is the tier's target for the pool, and the platform computes it.
mustDo: State what each action expects in words (promise) and why (basis); where a number is given, say what it comes from — a measured rate with its sample, a prior marked as a prior.
Keep every target number in the tiers' targets, labelled forecast.
mustNotDo: Write a numeric target in an action without its basis.
Promise a mention on an engine that rarely searches the web, or a rank for a group no engine mentions.
briefs.gradedOn: `node evals/geo-strategy/check-actions.mjs <strategy.json>` — case noTargetWithoutBasis holds (no target_without_basis notice), and the report's promises are no stronger than the engines' measured behaviour.

briefs.title: 信尔美：运行写的每个字段，要么平台存了，要么平台说明了不存的理由
briefs.why: Fields a run writes that the platform neither keeps nor has said it does not keep are a drop nobody decided: the work is in the file and invisible on the page. The platform keeps the fields of its own list, maps the method's names onto them, and lists what it does not keep with a reason each (a number it holds itself, a field derived from a row).
mustDo: Write gaps, battlefield, layout and tiers in the platform's field names, with the rich fields the page shows (judgment, rank, consequence, evidence, expectedPoints, handoff).
Keep numbers the platform measures itself (retrieval cells, sample sizes, per-source counts) in the report rather than in new keys of the file.
mustNotDo: Invent keys for what the page already carries under another name.
briefs.gradedOn: `node evals/geo-strategy/check-actions.mjs <strategy.json>` — case nothingDroppedUndecided holds (no path in `dropped`).
